hints.title: Dual-String Order Interleaving Obstacle
hints.text: String s3 must be formed by interleaving s1 and s2 without altering their internal character orders. How can tracking whether prefixes of s1 and s2 combine to form prefixes of s3 verify interleaving validity?

hints.title: Two-Pointer Prefix Match Invariant
hints.text: Prefix s3[0:i+j] is an interleave if s1[i - 1] matches s3[i + j - 1] and s1[0:i-1] + s2[0:j] is valid, or s2[j - 1] matches s3[i + j - 1] and s1[0:i] + s2[0:j-1] is valid.

hints.title: 1D Boolean Row Rolling Procedure
hints.text: First check that len(s1) + len(s2) == len(s3). Initialize a boolean array of size len(s2) + 1 for the first row. For each character index i in s1, update the first element, then update j across s2 by checking both vertical match from s1 and horizontal match from s2. Return the last boolean value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterates through M x N prefix pairs using 1D boolean compression.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching explores 2^(M+N) combinations causing timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Compresses table into 1D boolean array of size N + 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Checking the length invariant len(s1) + len(s2) == len(s3) up front.
